source: ops-policy.pdf p1 §3: 'A request belongs to Billing only when the problem is the payment itself (invoice, GST, double charge, refund of a payment, EMI conversion).'

when.regex: \b(invoice|gst|double charge|charged twice|refund not credited|emi conversion|coupon|discount not applied|payment deducted but order|wrong name on (the )?(gst )?invoice|corrected bill)\b

source: ops-policy.pdf p1 §3: 'A customer mentioning that they have paid does not make it a billing request.' Plus teams.csv: Installs & Demo handles installation and demo visits.
teams.csv: Filters & Consumables handles 'Filters, candles, membranes, jars, brushes, blades, AMC kits ... Not faults.' Repairs handles 'Product faults, breakdowns, error codes, noise, leaks'.

when.regex: \b(not working|stopped working|broken|breakdown|leak|leaking|noise|error code|error e[0-9]|not turning on|blank|tripping|scratched|burnt smell|making loud)\b

source: teams.csv: Filters & Consumables handles 'Filters, candles, membranes, jars, brushes, blades, AMC kits - selling and fitting spares.'

when.regex: \b(filter|candle|membrane|jar|brush roll|blade set|amc filter|amc kit|spare part|spare|spares|consumable pack|where to buy)\b

source: teams.csv: Returns & Replacement handles 'Damaged, wrong or incomplete deliveries; returns and exchanges within the return window.'

when.regex: \b(damaged|wrong (item|model|product)|scratched|missing parts in box|return pickup|cancel and return|return the|exchange)\b

source: teams.csv: Warranty Claims handles 'Warranty and Kestrel Shield registration, coverage questions, claim status.'
teams.csv: Product Advice handles 'Pre- and post-purchase usage questions. No fault reported.'

when.regex: \b(how to clean|how to use|best settings|can .* run on inverter|difference between|power consumption|recipe booklet|safe for kids|difference from)\b
